title: incident-bot: add on-call diagnostics helpers and SLO-context utilities
author: Ava Chen
description: Adds a small library of on-call diagnostics helper utilities to the incident-bot runtime and enhancements to the SLO toolkit context enrichment. Motivation: during recent incidents we repeatedly ran the same ad-hoc queries to gather SLO context, runbook links, and service-level metadata; this PR formalizes those helpers and provides a stable surface for other tools and runbooks to consume. Key changes: 1) new helpers.oncall module: functions to assemble prioritized runbook links, SLO correlation summaries, recent alert samples, and quick diagnostic commands; 2) slo_toolkit.context: utilities to attach SLO metadata and sampling hints to incidents and runbook suggestions; 3) CLI and webhook handlers updated to include the new context payload; 4) tests and small telemetry counters for diagnostics usage. Compatibility: all new helpers are additive and feature-flagged behind "oncall_diagnostics_v2". Rollout plan: merge to main, enable feature flag in staging, run smoke tests on two on-call rotations, then enable in prod. Checklist: [x] unit tests added, [x] integration smoke tests updated, [x] telemetry counters added, [x] documented helpers in README, [x] feature flag gating added. Related: ENG-3241 implements prioritized runbook linking; ENG-3300 adds SLO-context enrichment used by pager summaries.

Ethan Wright: CI flaked on the integration test once; re-run to confirm. Response from CI: green on re-run and author fixed a timing assertion.
QA: Verified that the diagnostics payload is present when feature flag is on and absent when off.
release_notes: Add on-call diagnostics helpers and SLO-context enrichment: new helpers for prioritized runbook links, SLO correlation summaries, and sampling hints. Feature-flagged behind oncall_diagnostics_v2. Backwards-compatible.
summary: Provides reusable on-call diagnostics helpers and SLO enrichment utilities to make runbook suggestions and diagnostics more reliable and testable.
